name: claude-explain
description: Hover over highlighted code to get a Claude Code explanation of what it does and how it fits the program.

claudeExplain.claudePath.description: Path to the claude CLI. Empty: ~/.local/bin/claude if it exists, else `claude` on PATH.

claudeExplain.model.description: Model alias or id passed to `claude --model` (haiku is fastest; sonnet or opus explain more carefully).

claudeExplain.explainOnHover.description: Explain automatically when you hover inside a selection. Off: only the command / keybinding explains.

claudeExplain.maxFileChars.description: Longer files are sent as a window around the selection, not whole.
